items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, he and Frank Pena were friends, huh? ... [INTERVIEWEE] He used to come in and work at us, right? Work at the Dewdrop.

ctx.x: He hasn't been here in a long time.
Well, he and Frank Pena were friends, huh? Right, right, right, right. Yeah, well, he could work at the Dewdrop, because that's what I thought.
He used to come in and work at us, right? Work at the Dewdrop. Sometimes he'd be in there a whole month.
